name: board_plate
title: Adapter plate for a board
summary: Flat adapter plate that screws a circuit board from the catalog (a Raspberry Pi, a microcontroller board) to the back of a monitor through its VESA 75 or 100 holes, built from the maker's published hole positions: countersunk screw holes for bought standoffs under the board, the VESA pattern centered, a vent under the board.

params.name: product
params.help: the exact board, from the catalog (stone show reads it from the request)

params.name: vesa
params.help: the monitor's VESA pattern, mm square

params.name: material
params.help: PETG holds its shape behind a warm monitor; PLA softens near 55 C

params.name: standoff
params.help: length of the bought metal standoffs the board sits on

params.name: vent
params.help: an opening under the board for its heat
